notes: PrimeFeed 1.9.8 — Is update me khabar ke beech me asli source post dikhne ka feature jud gaya hai: jab koi khabar kisi ki Instagram post ya kisi channel ke video post se banti hai, to woh asli post article ke andar hi card ki tarah dikhegi — photo par tap karne se asli post khul jayegi. Saath me app ke andar rakhi taazi khabron ka packet bhi update kar diya gaya hai.
